en: Skills become automatic through rehearsal. Run the full Thought Record sequence on a real, mildly stressful task — not a calm one.
Self-coaching is talking yourself through a task the way you would coach a friend: specific, kind, and focused on the next step.
Review what worked afterwards. The point is not perfection; it is that the habit of pausing gets stronger each time.
Complete a full Thought Record and talk yourself through it out loud, as if coaching a friend.
Keep two Thought Records and do one self-coached task this week.
What is likely to get in the way this week, and what will you do when it happens?
